title: A Warning Worth Hearing
paras: After a [[typhoon|typhoon]] struck Luming [[county|county]], radio engineer Lin Mei discovered why several fishing families had missed the evacuation warning. Their harbour's loudspeakers produced such a harsh noise that shopkeepers often disconnected them. Some residents were openly [[hostile|hostile]] to plans for a replacement system, expecting another expensive source of disturbance.

Mei began by recording sounds along the waterfront. The most [[relevant|relevant]] finding was that engine noise covered low notes, while higher ones remained clear. [[moreover|Moreover]], spoken messages became difficult to understand beyond two hundred metres. Rather than simply increasing the volume, she asked a theatre musician, Tomas, to [[compose|compose]] a short [[melody|melody]] that would signal an urgent announcement.

During the [[construction|construction]] of a small test station, Mei invited the strongest critics to help position its speakers. Tomas's first tune sounded too much like an ice-cream seller's bell, so they rejected it. His second used three rising notes followed by a pause. As sea winds made the paper test schedules [[curl|curl]] at the edges, volunteers walked between warehouses, marking where they could hear each version.

After six weeks, the group agreed on a clear signal and shorter spoken instructions. Working in [[harmony|harmony]] had turned former opponents into careful testers. In the next emergency drill, every household on the waterfront received the warning, and nobody unplugged a speaker. The technology was not particularly advanced; its success came from treating the people who would hear it as part of the design team.
zh: 一场台风袭击鹿鸣县后，无线电工程师林梅发现了几个渔民家庭错过疏散警报的原因。港口的扩音器声音十分刺耳，店主们常常会断开它们的电源。一些居民公开强烈反对更换系统的计划，认为这只会花大价钱再添一个扰民的东西。
林梅首先录下了滨水地带的各种声音。与问题最相关的发现是，发动机噪声会盖住低音，而较高的音仍然清晰可辨。此外，距离超过两百米后，语音信息就很难听清了。她没有简单地提高音量，而是请剧院音乐家托马斯创作一段短旋律，用来提示即将播报紧急通知。
在建造小型测试站期间，林梅邀请反对最激烈的居民协助确定扬声器的位置。托马斯的第一段曲调太像冰激凌小贩的铃声，因此被大家否决了。第二段由三个逐渐升高的音符和随后的停顿组成。海风吹得纸质测试时间表的边缘卷了起来，志愿者则在仓库之间走动，标出各个版本在哪些位置能够听见。
六周后，大家就清晰的提示音和更简短的语音指令达成了一致。融洽的合作让昔日的反对者成了细心的测试员。在下一次应急演练中，滨水地带的每户人家都收到了警报，也没有人拔掉扬声器的电源。这项技术并不特别先进；它的成功在于把听众也当作设计团队的一部分。

q.s: The unpleasant sound of the original equipment contributed to some families missing the warning.
q.why: 扩音器刺耳，店主常断电，导致漏听警报。

q.s: The musician's first proposed signal was accepted for the new system.
q.why: 第一段曲调像小贩铃声，被大家否决。

q.s: Following the successful drill, neighbouring counties ordered the same warning system.
q.why: 文章未提及邻县是否订购该系统。
